description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HoverChromeContainerView' that serves as a container with overlay chrome and interactive handles for dragging and resizing. It includes inner classes for interactive handle views, a chrome overlay with close button, and manages tracking areas for mouse hover effects. The code appears to be part of a macOS application UI component, likely used for displaying content with hover effects and user controls.
